channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Scottie Barnes | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Scottie Barnes from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes’ role:

“That’s going to be definitely work in progress. We cannot take away from his identity and what he brings to our team, which is hustle plays, rebounding, playing in the dunkers. He just needs to do a good job of recognizing when he needs to go and break the dunker and when he needs to be more in a pick and roll up high. I wish that he played a little bit with more force on offensive end to be honest with you. I’m used to seeing him playing more forceful, going to the rim, finishing above the rim. So that’s something that we got to continue working on. I like that he got nine rebounds and that he was active on the glass tonight.”

Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes, Oct 4, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Leonard on his pairing with Barnes:

“I think it's going to work great because we're coming in to play defence first... I think the offensive end is going to take care of itself... Scottie's a great passer.”

Kawhi Leonard on Scottie Barnes, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Bobby Webster on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Webster on Barnes and CMB and building around defence:

“Clearly the defensive ability of those two is special... What do you surround them with?... We're going to focus on the strength of those two.”

Bobby Webster on Scottie Barnes, May 6, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: RJ Barrett on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Barrett on Barnes:

“I think he shut up a lot of talk & I’m happy he was able to do that because, man, that’s a winning player. Just because he’s not a guy that comes out & tries to get 30 every night does not mean that he’s not one of the best basketball players in this league”

RJ Barrett on Scottie Barnes, May 4, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Bobby Webster on Scottie Barnes, Collin Murray-Boyles
item.description:
“Three years ago, when we met him in Vegas, we didn’t have a great personal relationship with him. There is nobody on the team I trust more about the pulse of the team, what I need to watch and what messaging you can help us with, especially in today’s NBA with so many young kids coming in. “He’s been [mentoring] Scottie [Barnes] for a couple years; we have this young kid Collin Murray-Boyles. He’s a huge mentor and invaluable to us.”

Bobby Webster on Scottie Barnes, Collin Murray-Boyles, May 1, 2026. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Toronto Raptors coach Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes:

“I expect more from Scottie. The way he's playing, he's at 60% of a player that he's gonna be in 2-3 years. Scottie's gonna be one of the best players in the league, and he's already one of the best players in the league.”

Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes, Apr 26, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Rajakovic on Barnes playing through illness:

“He’s going through pain. He’s going through sickness. He was giving us signs that he needed a breath of rest…But he showed up big. He gave everything he got. He completely emptied the tank.”

Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes, Mar 13, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Victor Wembanyama on the defensive bust that led to the World squad giving up the game-winning 3 to Scottie Barnes:

“It was our second time allowing a three when we shouldn’t have…I would have expected us to be smarter there, so that was disappointing.”

Victor Wembanyama on Scottie Barnes, Feb 15, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“For Scottie, I didn’t know people were teasing him about it. So I apologize…I was trying to give him a compliment on how strong he was. When I said extra chr*mosome people looked at it as negative but I was thinking Superman, Incredible Hulk... An extra chr*mosome would be a benefit”

Jaylen Brown on Scottie Barnes, Dec 20, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“I ain't going to lie — Scottie Barnes is strong as s***. This [] got like that... you know, like that.”

Jaylen Brown on Scottie Barnes, Dec 9, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Brandon Ingram on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
More Brandon Ingram, on Scottie Barnes:

“What I've learned is that he stays ready. He never complains about practice. I don't know how many minutes he played last night but he took the game very seriously... Players that don't have an ego and play hard, those are the guys you want to be around”

Brandon Ingram on Scottie Barnes, Apr 14, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes:

“The media and the public (is) not recognizing this kid as one of the most elite defensive players in the league. I don’t think he’s getting enough credit… Maybe that has something to do with our record but if you have eyes you see that he is elite”

Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes, Feb 23, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Brandon Ingram on Darko Rajakovic, Immanuel Quickley, Scottie Barnes
item.description:
“And also, I just felt that I needed a fresh start. A fresh start somewhere where guys played hard and they listened. I heard good things about Scottie [Barnes], I heard good things about [Immanuel] Quickley and I thought it was a good fit offensively and defensively. And Darko [Rajakovic] had a part in that too.”

Brandon Ingram on Darko Rajakovic, Immanuel Quickley, Scottie Barnes, Feb 13, 2025. Source: TSN.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Darko Rajakovic on Scottie:

“I do not think that he's getting enough credit (for his recent play). I think Scottie Barnes is playing at an all-star level... I'm really impressed with his improvement and I know that the basketball he's playing now is all-star basketball.”

Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes, Jan 14, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Garrett Temple on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
“Yeah, he’s balancing it great. I think he understands that his shots, the amount of shots he takes, the type of shots he takes may change when IQ and Scottie get back and we’re whole,”

Garrett Temple on Scottie Barnes, Nov 6, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Ujiri on the Raptors rebuild:

“I'm patient but I'm not trying to wait 6 years, to be honest. We're hoping. You hope with these things that you make the right decisions, that we pick the right players. We're going to be patient but I'm glad that we're starting off with (Barnes)”

Masai Ujiri on Scottie Barnes, Apr 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: RJ Barrett on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Barrett on Barnes:

“I played against Scottie when I was younger...but seeing it up close every day, it's amazing what he does. He does everything.”

RJ Barrett on Scottie Barnes, Apr 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Draymond Green on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Draymond on Scottie:

“Me playing the point forward position, I’m not going to sit up here and act like I was the first one to do it, but I think I’ve done it a little differently than most and he’ll take that to another level…I think Scottie will do way more than I ever did”

Draymond Green on Scottie Barnes, Mar 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Jordan Nwora on Immanuel Quickley, Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Nwora said of the trade to Toronto.

“It’s a new situation, new opportunity, and in my head, I’m just going to just make the most of it. Obviously, (in Indiana) things didn’t really work out this year — we were super deep, (I) kinda was the odd man out. Hopefully here, I can take another step and hopefully become a staple, somebody who can be a good supporting cast for guys like Scottie (Barnes), RJ and (Immanuel Quickley).”

Jordan Nwora on Immanuel Quickley, Scottie Barnes, Jan 30, 2024. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Darko Rajakovic:

“They have to win tonight? If that’s if that’s the case, just let us know so we don’t show up for the game. Just give them a win. That was not fair tonight. This is not happening for the first time for us. Scottie Barnes is going to be an All-Star. He's going to be the face of this league. What’s happening over here during the whole season, I have been holding it back. It’s complete crap.”

Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes, Jan 10, 2024. Source: Twitter @hoopshype.

item.title: Immanuel Quickley on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Quickley on his fit with Barnes:

“The type of talent he is makes it a lot easier for players like me to thrive on both sides of the ball... Playing with somebody that is 6-10, can pass, dribble, shoot, defend, that makes the game really easy.”

Immanuel Quickley on Scottie Barnes, Jan 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes:

“I think one day he’s going to be Defensive Player of the Year. That’s something he wants to be, that he wants to develop into, and I’m going to do everything in my power to help him on that path.”

Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes, Oct 24, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Ujiri on Barnes:

“We should always remember that Scottie is 21 years old. He's a baby. I understand the concerns about last summer. When you come into the league & you're pulled in different directions it's sometimes tough... I think he grew a lot this season and realized a lot”

Masai Ujiri on Scottie Barnes, Apr 21, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Thaddeus Young on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Thad Young on Barnes:

“Scottie's an amazing basketball player and I don't even think he knows it. He's so young and he's just scratching the surface.”

Thaddeus Young on Scottie Barnes, Oct 18, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Otto Porter Jr. on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Otto Porter Jr. on Scottie Barnes:

“He’s going to be good for years to come. Toronto is very happy to have him. Future all-star, I see. He’s only going to continue to get better.”

Otto Porter Jr. on Scottie Barnes, Jul 6, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Gary Trent Jr on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Gary Trent Jr. on Scottie Barnes:

“I can't wait to see how he comes back next year. Sky's the limit. He's gonna continue to chase greatness. He can be whatever he wants to be.”

Gary Trent Jr on Scottie Barnes, Apr 29, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Nurse on what he expects from Scottie Barnes in the rookie's first playoff series:

“I would expect him to be really great. I really would. He looks like he's getting stronger... Game after game he's getting stronger, so I imagine that bodes well for him.”

Nick Nurse on Scottie Barnes, Apr 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Kyle Lowry on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Lowry on Scottie Barnes:

“He's a special talent. He's gonna be a cornerstone of the franchise. He fits in perfectly here - how hard he plays, how passionate he is for the game. And he's only gonna continue to get better. I just told him to keep going, don't stop”

Kyle Lowry on Scottie Barnes, Apr 4, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Pascal Siakam on Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Pascal Siakam on Scottie Barnes:

“The sky's the limit for him. There's no limit... He's my vote for Rookie of the Year, for sure.”

Pascal Siakam on Scottie Barnes, Mar 17, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Malachi Flynn, Scottie Barnes, Dalano Banton
item.description:
“There are going to be growing pains, trust me, you know like, sometimes it's gonna be tough to watch but we know what's coming,we know we're excited about the young talent. They are excited to play - to see how, OG [Anunoby], Pascal [Siakam], Fred, are going to evolve as leaders - as elite players. And then the young guys, [Scottie] Barnes, Malachi [Flynn], Dalano [Banton]. In sports, people think 'now,' you know? And this is where we have to be patient and let it grow.”

Masai Ujiri on Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Malachi Flynn, Scottie Barnes, Dalano Banton, Sep 9, 2021. Source: NBA.com.
